concept:
Character concept for a 2D cut-out animation game. Draw ONE original creature: an OAK-THORN DRAGON CUB, the first stage of a two-stage Wood evolution line, in the same view and pose as image 1, crouched low in mid-hop with both arms out to the sides, on a plain white background. A cute, chunky creature, but an original design that must look clearly DIFFERENT from the figure the silhouette came from; not any existing character.

Image 1 (grey silhouette) and image 2 (the same figure split into numbered regions) show the PUPPET RIG the new creature will be animated on. They tell you where each part and joint is, NOT what the creature looks like: do not trace their outline. Viewer-left and viewer-right mean as seen in the picture.

KEEP FROM THE RIG (the animation moves these parts around these joints):
- the same parts, no more, no fewer, each where its numbered region is: 1 round head with face; 2 three wooden thorn horns; 3 amber resin visor; 4 body with bark collar; 5 two arms with thorn claws; 6 two feet with thorn claws; 7 two young oak-leaf wings; 8 armoured tail; 9 two amber beads with oak-leaf trails;
- every joint where it is and every part pointing the same way as in image 1; eyes where the old eyes are;
- each part about the size and shape of its region; the whole figure about the same size.

CHANGE (the new look, region by region):
1 round head with face: a round olive-green dragon-cub head of the same shape, the pointed lobe at the back kept; a pale khaki muzzle at the lower right; one big dark brown eye (one catchlight dot) exactly where the old eye is, a brow angled down above it, a small confident grin with a tiny fang on the muzzle; a few bark-brown scale plates on top of the head instead of the dark markings.
2 three wooden thorn horns: three thorns of bark-brown oak wood with a few darker grain lines, in the same places and directions: a big curved thorn horn across the top of the head pointing up-left, a smaller thorn horn standing up on the viewer-right, and a tiny thorn on the viewer-left cheek; no gold.
3 amber resin visor: a flat honey-amber resin plate of the same pointed-oval shape with a thin dark-brown wooden rim, covering the viewer-right eye like a visor; flat colour, no shine, no blue, no eye drawn on it.
4 body with bark collar: a small round olive-green body with a pale khaki belly; the collar becomes a V-shaped gorget of overlapping bark-brown armour plates; the pendant becomes a small flat amber resin bead in a wooden setting; no blue crystal, no gold.
5 two arms with thorn claws: two short chubby olive-green arms in the same places, each with a small bark-brown armour plate at the shoulder end; the claws become short curved deep-crimson thorns, three at each hand; no gold.
6 two feet with thorn claws: two short stubby olive-green feet in the same places, a pale khaki sole pad on the viewer-left foot; the claws become small curved deep-crimson thorns; no gold.
7 two young oak-leaf wings: small wings shaped like young oak leaves: olive-green membrane with brown veins and a wavy lobed edge, a bark-brown wing bone along the top edge, the same sizes and directions.
8 armoured tail: an olive-green tail of the same curve with a row of small bark-brown armour plates along its outer edge and a tip shaped like a wooden thorn.
9 two amber beads with oak-leaf trails: each orange streak becomes a thin trail of small olive-green and brown oak leaves following the same curve, and each gold ring becomes a small flat amber resin bead; no orange streak, no gold, no blue gem.

ATTITUDE: a plucky little dragon ready to pounce: brow angled down, a small fang in a confident grin; cute, never scary, never a cheerful mascot.

{RENDER}
{DESIGN}
The style sheet is image 3; the hand-drawn map is image 4. Image 5 is an approved character of this game: copy its ink line weight and its pencil and crayon texture, not its design; it has a few white shine spots and some darker shading: do NOT copy those.

COLOURS: olive-green skin, a pale khaki belly, bark-brown armour plates and wooden thorn horns, flat honey-amber resin, deep crimson thorn claws, olive oak-leaf wing membranes with brown veins, dark brown eyes. Few colours.

AVOID: bright fresh green skin, gold or yellow-gold horns, metal or claws, blue crystal or glass, gold bracelets set with blue gems, orange swoosh trails, gem shine, text, labels, numbers, the region colours, frames, background scenery, a second view, shading, shadows, white highlights, glossy shine, glow, gradients.
